answer: Bind each agent to a bridge receipt: a verified Solana or Ethereum address at least 90 days old that paid gas on 30 distinct days. Age cannot be bought later, so the canyon between a fresh key and a seated one is time, not cash. Addresses funded from one source share one jury seat, and the bond doubles with each extra wallet a funder links: 10, 20, 40 POA. The fable of a thousand free clones ends at a 2^n bill and a three-month wait.
